entries.summary: Improved module inspector (picker hints, color pickers, presets, HTML/media previews, a11y tabs/fields) and canvas (no link navigation, confirm delete, dirty warning, device hide preview).
CTA gained button style; button and CTA gained new_tab. Blurb editor preview matches public image-over-icon. Divider color follows Design text color.
No schema change; new keys live inside existing layout_json.
